title: Internal: handling procedure for archiving an exhausted or expired Personal Training Packages package
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a package's own status is already exhausted or expired, the agent administratively archives it to closed status and records its closed date. A package whose status is still active or paused may not be archived.

## Prerequisite
the package's expiration forfeiture (its transition to expired) must already be on record before the package can be archived, where the package is being archived on that basis rather than on the basis of having already run out of sessions; where neither its exhaustion nor its expiration forfeiture is yet on record, the package is not archived.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): archive_pt_package_1350ea96.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package being archived, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- closed_date: the date to record as the package's closed date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, matching the date format already on file for this package's other dates; passed as the correct closing date for this archival.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the package's reference number, its new status, and its closed date; the status reading closed indicates the archival was recorded successfully. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no change is recorded.
